The structure of Nd₂In₈Pd₈ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with 18 atoms per unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: each In and Nd is surrounded by 12 neighbors (8 In, 4 Pd or 4 In, 8 Pd), while each Pd has 12 neighbors (4 In, 4 Nd, 4 Pd). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between In and Nd 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing among In–In and Pd–Pd polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 18 sites.
